attchmntText: Park Medi World Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Park Medi World Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, under Regulation 30 of the Listing Regulations. The company reported H1 FY’27 revenue of INR 9,867 million, a 22 percent year-on-year increase. Q2 revenue reached INR 5,110 million, up 25 percent. The hospital network expanded to 17 hospitals with 4,290 beds, adding 680 beds in six months. Patient volume rose 23 percent to 539,000. H1 EBITDA was INR 2,278 million with a 23.1 percent margin. Net profit for the half year was INR 1,431 million, a 1 percent decline. The company holds cash of INR 3,713 million against term debt of INR 1,779 million.

attchmntText: Park Medi World Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Earnings Release for Q2 & H1 FY'27 Unaudited results".
voiceSummary: Park Medi World Limited filed its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported H1 revenue of INR 9,867 mn, up 22% year on year. Net profit for the half year was INR 1,431 mn, flat year on year. EBITDA stood at INR 2,278 mn with a margin of 23.1%. For the second quarter, revenue was INR 5,110 mn, up 25% year on year. Net profit for the quarter was INR 545 mn. The company added 680 beds, bringing total capacity to 4,290 beds. Term debt was INR 1,779 mn as of September 30, 2026. Cash and cash equivalents totaled INR 3,713 mn. The company announced the acquisition of Mehar Hospital in Zirakpur for INR 1,070 mn. It also announced an operations and management arrangement for a 300-bed hospital in Kanpur.

attchmntText: Park Medi World Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Park Medi World Limited announced the Board approved Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 13, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations for the half year was Rs. 9,867.34 million, compared to Rs. 8,089.79 million in the previous year. Profit after tax for the half year was Rs. 1,296.90 million, versus Rs. 1,366.49 million previously. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 5,306.50 million. Profit after tax for the quarter was Rs. 588.00 million, compared to Rs. 737.29 million in the prior year quarter. The Statutory Auditor issued a limited review report stating no material misstatements were found. The results are available on the company website.
